1. Claim 11 (Currently amended): A method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: obtaining a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; generating a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm; __providing the pseudo partial ordering of molecules to the selected machine learning algorithm executed on a computer processor__; and __executing the selected machine learning algorithm on the computer processor, using the pseudo partial ordering, to train a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model__.

2. Claim 12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the molecular properties model generates predictions related to a property of interest selected from at least one of a pharmacokinetic property, pharmacodynamic property, physiological or pharmacological activity, toxicity or selectivity; a chemical property including reactivity, binding affinity, pKa, or a property of a specific atom or bond in a molecule; or a physical property including melting point, solubility, a membrane permeability, and a force-field parameter; __wherein the property of interest is determined by comparing the ordered molecules in the pseudo-partial ordering relative to one another__.

3. Claim 13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a classification learning algorithm __executed on a computer processor to classify molecules based on the pseudo-partial ordering__.

4. Claim 14 (Original)

5. Claim 15 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm comprises a variant of a Boosting algorithm, RankBoost algorithm, Alternating Decision Trees algorithm, Support Vector Machines algorithm, a Perceptron algorithm, Winnow, a Hedge Algorithm, decision trees, neural networks, genetic algorithms, genetic programming or any modifications thereof modified to process the pseudo partial ordering of ranked pairs, __wherein the algorithm is executed on a computer processor__.

6. Claim 16 (Original)

7. Claim 17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein the selected machine learning algorithm is configured to minimize, either directly or indirectly, a function of the rank ordering of molecules in the pseudo partial ordering, __wherein the minimization is performed by a computer processor executing the algorithm__.

8. Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 11, wherein generating the representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules comprises: __using a computer processor to generate__ a vector representation of the molecules, wherein the vector representation is configured to encode the structure of the molecules included the pseudo-partial ordering; or comprises __using a computer processor to generate__ an n-point pharmacophore representation of the molecules included in the pseudo-partial ordering.

9. Claim 20 (Original)

10. Claim 21 (Original)

11. Claim 22 (Original)

12. Claim 23 (Original)

13. Claim 35 (Currently amended): A computer-storage medium __that is non-transitory__ containing a program which, when executed by a processor, performs a method for training a molecular properties model, comprising: receiving a pseudo-partial ordering of molecules, wherein the pseudo partial ordering includes at least a representation of a first and second molecule, ordered relative to one another and a property of interest; generating a representation of the molecules included in the pseudo partial ordering of molecules that is appropriate for a selected machine learning algorithm; __providing the pseudo partial ordering of molecules to the selected machine learning algorithm executed on the processor__; and __executing the selected machine learning algorithm on the processor, using the pseudo partial ordering, to train a molecular properties model configured to generate a prediction regarding additional molecules supplied to the model__.
